title: Detailed watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body of watering can -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='62' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#2e8b57'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='60' rx='24' ry='17' fill='#3cb371'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='57' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#5fcf8f' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- body rim -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='45' rx='26' ry='7' fill='#3cb371'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='45' rx='26' ry='7' fill='none' stroke='#5fcf8f' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='44' rx='23' ry='5' fill='#2e8b57'/>
  <!-- top opening where water goes -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='43' rx='16' ry='4' fill='#1f6b42'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='43' rx='16' ry='4' fill='none' stroke='#5fcf8f' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M 25 48 Q 12 50 12 32 Q 12 18 30 20 Q 38 21 40 30' fill='none' stroke='#e8a030' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 25 48 Q 12 50 12 32 Q 12 18 30 20 Q 38 21 40 30' fill='none' stroke='#ffd060' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M 68 52 L 92 28' stroke='#2e8b57' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 68 52 L 92 28' stroke='#3cb371' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- spout lighter stripe -->
  <path d='M 70 50 L 90 30' stroke='#5fcf8f' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- spout rose (shower head) -->
  <ellipse cx='92' cy='27' rx='6' ry='8' transform='rotate(45 92 27)' fill='#e8a030'/>
  <ellipse cx='92' cy='27' rx='4' ry='6' transform='rotate(45 92 27)' fill='#ffd060'/>
  <!-- rose holes -->
  <circle cx='90' cy='24' r='0.9' fill='#c07020'/>
  <circle cx='93' cy='25' r='0.9' fill='#c07020'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='29' r='0.9' fill='#c07020'/>
  <circle cx='95' cy='28' r='0.9' fill='#c07020'/>
  <circle cx='89' cy='28' r='0.9' fill='#c07020'/>
  <circle cx='94' cy='31' r='0.9' fill='#c07020'/>
  <!-- highlight on body -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='55' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#7ee8a8' opacity='0.7' transform='rotate(-20 35 55)'/>
  <!-- water level indicator -->
  <path d='M 28 65 Q 45 70 62 65' fill='none' stroke='#1f6b42' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- base ring -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='80' rx='20' ry='4' fill='#1f6b42'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='79' rx='18' ry='3' fill='#2e8b57'/>
</svg>
